findings.summary: Luna marked the linked Falls Church Toast catalog fully enumerated, but current indexed content for the same catalog includes omitted breakfast and sandwich categories and products.

The current official full-menu document remains inaccessible to this verification surface. It cannot support missing-product conclusions, complete allergen arrays, negatives, or cross-contact semantics.

Luna omitted narrow direct positives: official cake text supports milk and peanut at catalog level; linked Toast text supports milk, peanut, and tree nut for sweets and milk/tree nut for drinks. These remain partial-positive-only claims with their original authorities.

The frozen item file contains slogans, CTA text, category headings, and likely modifier/header rows rather than 16 independently sellable products. Unavailable current PDF contents must not be used to infer product removal.
